title: A live price board fed by a fast feed
prompt: src/feed.ts has subscribe(onQuote), which calls onQuote with { symbol, last, volume } many times a second. In src/App.svelte, show a live board with a row for each symbol in SYMBOLS (from src/feed.ts) and the columns Symbol, Last and Volume. The last price should flash when it changes. The board must stay smooth at thousands of updates a second.

checks.name: flashes the Last column with the grid's own flash
